item.title: SDUSD, San Diego Education Association avert Feb. 26 strike
item.description: A one-day planned strike on Feb. 26 is off as the district and the San Diego Education Association reached a mutual agreement on a contract.

item.title: Sen. Blakespear presents county with $1.67M check for veteran housing
item.description: The check to San Diego County funds a program intended to provide affordable housing to veterans at lower rental costs.

item.title: Colorado River negotiators are nearly out of time — and snowpack
item.description: With another federal deadline days away and record-low snowfall further drying out the watershed, states are now mulling litigation options.

item.title: Alleged Sinaloa cartel associates charged with hiring teenage hitmen
item.description: Three alleged Sinaloa Cartel associates have been arrested and indicted for allegedly coordinating an attempted murder perpetrated in Chula Vista by two teenagers,

item.title: Opinion: Uber-sponsored Super Bowl ads hint at upcoming CA ballot measure
item.description: The ads subliminally promoted an Uber-sponsored ballot measure that would sharply limit contingency fees attorneys receive in auto accident lawsuits.

item.title: La Jolla Village News: Feb. 13, 2026
item.description: La Jolla Village News covers Farmers Insurance Open at Torrey Pines featuring Xander Schauffele, La Jolla museums' free 'Growing Together' art series for community connection, WWII history of Camp Callan training ground, Vista 360 wellness program for seniors, plus briefs on crime drop, climate studies, and autism society.

item.title: Mission Times Courier: Feb. 13, 2026
item.description: Mission Times Courier covers Patrick Henry basketball player's 1,000-point milestone, early end to housing voucher program risking homelessness for hundreds, SDSU swimmers chasing conference crown, kids' fun camp learning, Poke Chop's poke bowls, and fostering community through friendship and love.

item.title: Four San Diego Unified Schools named finalists for 2026 America’s Best Schools
item.description: Four elementary schools in the San Diego Unified School District were named finalists for the 2026 America’s Best Schools Award, among 17 schools selected nationwide by the San Diego State University-based National Center for Urban School Transformation. item.title: Suspected Escondido serial flasher jailed
item.description: A man who allegedly exposed himself to schoolgirls and at least one woman in Escondido in recent weeks was jailed Thursday, authorities reported.
